user.title: Connect to the PictoChat host
user.description: The host is pictochat.py, running on the machine that has the ESP32-C3 radio plugged in. Start it with --gui-bind 0.0.0.0 and a token so Home Assistant can reach it.

data_description.host: Name or IP address of the machine that runs the host. From a container on the same Mac, host.docker.internal usually works.
data_description.token: The token the host was started with (--gui-token). Leave empty if it has none.

error.cannot_connect: No PictoChat host answered there. Check that it runs, the address, the port and the firewall.

abort.already_configured: This host is already set up.

menu_options.add_phrase: Learn a phrase from the last DS message

add_phrase.title: Learn a phrase
add_phrase.description:
The last message came from {sender}, {ago} seconds ago. It becomes the sample for this phrase: whenever a DS sends the same message again, the phrase fires.

Give it a name that is already in use to add this message as one more sample of that phrase (the other fields are then ignored).

data_description.name: What you typed on the DS, for example: lights on
data_description.targets: Leave empty to only fire the event and device trigger, and build an automation on that.
data_description.action: Scenes are always activated and buttons always pressed.
data_description.reply: Text sent back into the room after the action ran.

data.threshold: How exactly a message must match
data.unknown_reply: Answer on the DS when nothing matched (optional)

data_description.threshold: Typed text always matches 100 %. Lower this only to recognise hand-drawn messages, which never come out the same twice.

error.name_exists: Another phrase already has this name.
error.already_matches: This message is already recognised as the phrase "{match}".

abort.no_message: No message has arrived from a DS yet. Send the message from your DS first, then come back here.

send_text.name: Send text
send_text.description: Sends a text into the PictoChat room. Long texts are split over up to three messages.

message.name: Message
message.description: The text to show on the DS.

send_image.name: Send image
send_image.description: Sends an image file into the PictoChat room, fitted to 230 x 64 pixels.

path.name: Path
path.description: Image file on the Home Assistant machine, inside allowlist_external_dirs.

dither.name: Dither
dither.description: Floyd-Steinberg dithering instead of a plain threshold.

color.name: Colour
color.description: Use PictoChat's 16 colours instead of black and white.
